parameters.query:
INSERT INTO clinic.p4_notification_outbox
    (event_id, event_version, recipient_ref, template_key, due_at)
SELECT a.id::text, 1, a.patient_id::text, 'booking_confirmed', r.updated_at
FROM public.booking_requests r
JOIN public.appointments a ON a.id = r.appointment_id AND a.patient_id = r.patient_id
WHERE r.status = 'confirmed'
  AND a.status = 'booked'
  AND r.updated_at IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic.p4_verified_notification_recipients recipient
      WHERE recipient.recipient_ref = a.patient_id::text
        AND recipient.eligible IS TRUE
        AND recipient.chat_id ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  )
  AND (a.appointment_date + a.start_time) > (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM clinic.p4_notification_outbox o
      WHERE o.event_id = a.id::text AND o.template_key = 'booking_confirmed'
  )
ORDER BY r.updated_at, r.id
LIMIT 50
ON CONFLICT (event_id) WHERE template_key = 'booking_confirmed' DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, event_id, state;

parameters.query:
WITH orphaned_waiting AS (
    UPDATE public.wait_list w
    SET status = 'waiting'::public.waiting_status,
        offer_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE w.status = 'offered'::public.waiting_status
      AND w.offer_expires_at <= now()
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.waiting_list_offers o
          WHERE o.waiting_list_id = w.id
            AND o.status IN (
                'pending'::public.waiting_offer_status,
                'accepted'::public.waiting_offer_status,
                'booked'::public.waiting_offer_status
            )
      )
    RETURNING w.id
),
orphaned_slots AS (
    UPDATE public.available_slot_events s
    SET status = 'pending',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE s.status = 'processing'
      AND s.updated_at <= now() - INTERVAL '16 minutes'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.waiting_list_offers o
          WHERE o.slot_event_id = s.id
            AND o.status IN (
                'pending'::public.waiting_offer_status,
                'accepted'::public.waiting_offer_status,
                'booked'::public.waiting_offer_status
            )
      )
    RETURNING s.id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orphaned_waiting) AS waiting_entries_recovered,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orphaned_slots) AS slot_events_recovered;

parameters.query:
WITH claimed_offer AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM public.waiting_list_offers
    WHERE id = $6::uuid
      AND status = 'pending'::public.waiting_offer_status
      AND expires_at > now()
    FOR UPDATE
),
booking AS (
    INSERT INTO public.booking_requests (
        patient_id,
        doctor_id,
        appointment_date,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        status,
        idempotency_key,
        waiting_list_offer_id
    )
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        doctor_id,
        appointment_date,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        'pending'::public.booking_request_status,
        'waiting-list-offer:' || $6::text,
        id
    FROM claimed_offer
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
    DO UPDATE SET
        updated_at = now(),
        waiting_list_offer_id = EXCLUDED.waiting_list_offer_id
    RETURNING id, waiting_list_offer_id
),
linked AS (
    UPDATE public.waiting_list_offers o
    SET status = 'accepted'::public.waiting_offer_status,
        responded_at = now(),
        updated_at = now(),
        booking_request_id = b.id
    FROM booking b
    JOIN claimed_offer c ON c.id = b.waiting_list_offer_id
    WHERE o.id = c.id
    RETURNING o.id AS waiting_list_offer_id, o.booking_request_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT booking_request_id FROM linked LIMIT 1) AS booking_request_id,
    (SELECT waiting_list_offer_id FROM linked LIMIT 1) AS waiting_list_offer_id,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linked) AS offer_claimed;

WITH rejected_offer AS (
    UPDATE public.waiting_list_offers
    SET status = 'rejected'::public.waiting_offer_status,
        responded_at = now(),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = $3::uuid
      AND status = 'pending'::public.waiting_offer_status
      AND expires_at > now()
    RETURNING waiting_list_id, slot_event_id
),
reset_waiting AS (
    UPDATE public.wait_list w
    SET status = 'waiting'::public.waiting_status,
        offer_expires_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM rejected_offer r
    WHERE w.id = r.waiting_list_id
    RETURNING w.id
),
reset_slot AS (
    UPDATE public.available_slot_events s
    SET status = 'pending',
        updated_at = now()
    FROM rejected_offer r
    WHERE s.id = r.slot_event_id
    RETURNING s.id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'success', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rejected_offer),
    'message', CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rejected_offer)
        THEN 'Offer rejected; patient and slot returned to their queues'
        ELSE 'Offer was already answered or expired'
    END
) AS result;

WITH saved AS (
    INSERT INTO clinicos_identity.patients AS patient
        (id, full_name, date_of_birth, phone_e164, created_at, phone_revision,
         telegram_chat_id, telegram_user_id, telegram_linked_at, profile_sync_revision)
    VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::date, $4::text, $5::timestamptz, $6::bigint,
            $7::bigint, $8::bigint, $9::timestamptz, $10::bigint)
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
    SET phone_e164 = $4::text, phone_revision = $6::bigint,
        telegram_chat_id = $7::bigint, telegram_user_id = $8::bigint,
        telegram_linked_at = $9::timestamptz, profile_sync_revision = $10::bigint
    WHERE patient.is_active AND patient.profile_sync_revision < $10::bigint
      AND patient.phone_revision <= $6::bigint
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM clinicos_identity.patients
    WHERE id = $1::uuid AND is_active
      AND profile_sync_revision >= $10::bigint AND phone_revision >= $6::bigint
) AS synchronized;

parameters.query:
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.payload
    FROM public.notification_outbox o
    WHERE o.event_type = 'waiting_list_offer' AND o.status = 'pending'
      AND o.offer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM clinic.p4_waiting_offer_claims c WHERE c.offer_id = o.offer_id
      )
    ORDER BY o.offer_id
    LIMIT 50
    FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED
), claims AS (
    INSERT INTO clinic.p4_waiting_offer_claims (offer_id, decision)
    SELECT c.offer_id,
           CASE WHEN o.status = 'pending' AND o.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
                     AND o.patient_id::text = c.payload->>'patient_id'
                THEN 'eligible' ELSE 'suppressed' END
    FROM candidates c
    LEFT JOIN public.waiting_list_offers o ON o.id = c.offer_id
    ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING offer_id, decision
)
SELECT offer_id, decision FROM claims;
